evidence: CURSOR IS CSTART / CONSOLE IS CRT in SPECIAL-NAMES

purpose.summary: OINV12 is a batch/console invoice printing program for a sales/accounts-receivable system. It processes invoices and credit notes, calculates VAT (Value Added Tax) per line item, integrates sales into a General Ledger, and prints formatted invoices to a printer while optionally opening a cash drawer via a serial port.
purpose.domain: accounting/retail (invoicing, debtors, VAT, general ledger integration)

notable_features: COMP-3 (packed decimal) for monetary and tax calculations
COMP-5 (binary) for indexes and counters — Micro Focus extension
CURSOR IS / CONSOLE IS CRT in SPECIAL-NAMES for screen I/O
Cash drawer control via COM1 serial port (FD CSHDRW VALUE OF FILE-ID "COM1")
Extensive inline VAT rounding commentary with worked examples
Multiple COPY statements with .SL/.FDE/.IFD/.GFD suffixes (copybook library)
GNU GPL licensing notice embedded in SECURITY paragraph
Box-drawing characters (IBM CP437/850) in comments and working-storage literals
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — pure file-based I/O
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1; box-drawing characters in comments and WS-DB-LINE literals are consistent with IBM CP437/850 encoding used in DOS-era Micro Focus or RM/COBOL environments. The program is part of a larger commercial accounting suite (APAC/OINV series) authored by J.W. Lemmon, version 8.15.04 dated January 2012. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 117641 bytes total; procedure division not visible in the excerpt but PERFORM count (200) and GOTO count (80) confirm substantial procedural logic.
